note: Synthetic data. coldGpu uses a fresh reference; deviceReused records whether its device/pipeline was already ready. A shared device persists across sizes, or can be prepared separately with --prewarm. Ordinary warm trials reuse the reference. --compare-setup loads a new reference before each GPU trial: shared-device vs fresh isolated device; load time is excluded, reference build/upload/verification and summaries included. Exact f64 verification uses axis certificates plus sibling subtree boxes and pairwise WASM SIMD by default; planeGpu disables boxes; scalarGpu disables only leaf SIMD. --compare-batches rotates CPU, a 65536-query control and automatic batch selection (or an explicit --batch-size), reusing the same reference/device/verifier. Effective query caps and completed dispatch counts are recorded. Batch buffers retain their largest capacity, so both controls use the same retained allocations after warm-up. Next-batch GPU dispatch overlaps verification unless disabled by serial mode. gpuMillis intervals overlap verifyMillis and are not additive. Other applications and CPU/GPU power/clocks are uncontrolled. No real-source throughput claim. --compare-workgroups rotates CPU and 32/64/128/256 GPU invocations per workgroup. All four variants are warmed first and reuse the same reference/device/buffers, batch caps, full-search hints and exact verifier. Ten repeats balance each of five ordering positions twice. workgroups records each variant including verification and summaries; gpuMillis is the 64-invocation control. coldGpu records the default 64-invocation pipeline. Every variant must match CPU distance bits, f64 stats and certificate counts.
